title: Quietly Rich Algerian Mushroom Tagine
description: A rich and festive Algerian dish featuring mushrooms in a molten beurre-monte sauce, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This raw-friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the beurre-monte and butter, stirring until the sauce is smooth and molten.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
